name: user-portal
description: Waypoint - Angular SPA with a Node/TypeScript API: login, role-based records, user management

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
